units.source_text: “只是喜欢看书的话，在乡下也是一样的，而且又不用工作，不是正合适嘛。”

en.t: If all you like is reading books, you can do that just as well in the country, and since you would not have to work, would it not suit you perfectly?

units.source_text: “按理说，倒是应该哥哥回来的。”

en.t: Strictly speaking, my elder brother ought to be the one to come back.
How could I possibly stay here?
My elder brother flatly rejected the idea.

units.source_text: 听哥哥的口气，他胸怀着在这世上干出一番事业的雄心壮志。

en.t: From his tone, I could tell that my elder brother was filled with ambition to make something of himself in the world.

units.source_text: “你要是不愿意的话，那就请叔父帮着照料一下。

en.t: If you do not want to, then we can ask Uncle to help look after her.

units.source_text: 但是，妈必须得跟着一个人过。”

en.t: But Mother has to live with one of us.

units.source_text: “妈愿意不愿意离开这里，这还是个大问题哪。”

en.t: Whether Mother is willing to leave here is still a serious question.

units.source_text: 父亲还没有死，兄弟俩就商量起父亲死后的事情来。

en.t: Before our father had even died, the two brothers began discussing what would happen after his death.
